headline: Juventus visit Genoa after a heavy defeat, but remain clear favourites
summary: Juventus travel to Genoa after a 0-3 home defeat to Lazio, a result that started a debate about the team. Francisco Conceicao dislocated a shoulder against Lazio, and Juventus say he will not need surgery. According to Football Italia, Gianluigi Buffon says coach Luciano Spalletti deserves more time. Genoa are 17th in Serie A, lost 0-2 at Roma and have not scored in the last 5 meetings with Juventus. Even so, the market gives Juventus a 58.6% fair chance, with the bookmakers' margin removed. Over 2.5 goals has a 46.8% chance.
read: Juventus go to Genoa as clear favourites, with the market giving them a 58.6% chance to win, after a 0-3 home defeat to Lazio that the chances created say was closer than the score. Genoa are 17th and lost 0-2 at Roma, and fewer than three goals is slightly more likely than not.

facts.fact: Juventus lost 0-3 at home to Lazio on 18 October.
facts.meaning: It was Juventus' only defeat in their last five games, and it set off a debate about the team.

facts.fact: Genoa are 17th in the 20-team Serie A table.
facts.meaning: Genoa are fighting near the bottom, while Juventus are 8th.

facts.fact: Juventus announced that Francisco Conceicao dislocated his shoulder against Lazio and will not have surgery; he gets conservative treatment instead.
facts.meaning: He is a doubt for this match, because no return date was given.

facts.fact: Genoa lost 0-2 away to Roma on 17 October.
facts.meaning: Genoa's latest league game was a defeat, and they had been well beaten on chances.

facts.fact: Gianluigi Buffon says the coach is not the problem at Juventus and that Luciano Spalletti deserves time, and he understands Bremer's outburst.
facts.meaning: Spalletti and the mood in the squad are a story after the Lazio defeat.

facts.fact: The market gives Juventus a 58.6% chance to win, more than three times Genoa's chance.
facts.meaning: Juventus are clear favourites, even after the Lazio defeat.

facts.fact: Genoa have scored no goal in their last five meetings with Juventus.
facts.meaning: Genoa have struggled to hurt Juventus: they lost four of those games and drew one 0-0.

facts.fact: Juventus have won three, drawn one and lost one of their last five games in all competitions.
facts.meaning: The Lazio defeat is the exception in a decent run.

sources.fact: Juventus announced that Francisco Conceicao dislocated his shoulder in the 3-0 defeat to Lazio and will not have surgery; he will receive conservative treatment to recover.
Gianluigi Buffon says the coach is not the problem for Juventus, that Luciano Spalletti deserves time to turn things around, and that he understands Bremer's outburst.
Juventus lost 3-0 to Lazio at the Allianz Stadium on 18 October.

Massimo Mauro said Juventus played like a Serie D team against Lazio.
Gazzetta writes that Antonio Conte, a free agent living in Turin, does not rule out a new mid-season job and that Juventus fans are calling for him.
